## Summary

<!-- What does this PR do and why? 1–3 sentences. Link any related issue: Closes #123 -->

## Type of change

<!-- Tick all that apply. Keep this in sync with your branch prefix (feature/ fix/ chore/ docs/). -->

- [ ] ✨ Feature (`feature/`) — new user-facing functionality
- [ ] 🐛 Fix (`fix/`) — bug fix
- [ ] 🧹 Chore (`chore/`) — tooling, deps, config, refactor (no behaviour change)
- [ ] 📝 Docs (`docs/`) — documentation only
- [ ] ⚠️ Breaking change — requires action from other devs (migrations, env vars, etc.)

## Testing notes

<!--
  How did you verify this works? Be specific so a reviewer can reproduce.

  Include platforms touched: web / iOS sim / Android emulator / Android device.
-->

- [ ] Typecheck passes (`pnpm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Verified locally (see RUNNING.md) on: <!-- web / android / ios -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows naming convention (`feature/` `fix/` `chore/` `docs/`)
- [ ] No secrets committed (`.env` files stay local — see `.gitignore`)
- [ ] Self-reviewed the diff
